sar.narrative: Customer C08168, holder of card C08168-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-15 22:37 and 2016-11-29 14:51, 2 transaction(s) totalling $174.37 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $129.94 (3461032, 2016-11-15 22:37), $44.43 (3497201, 2016-11-29 14:51). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. When contacted separately, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still holds the card. The activity is suspicious because the device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert, with all 28 behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and flagged as a new device. Four closed cases on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, all recorded as an undocumented pattern, and 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases (including CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-3035, and CC-2971) were confirmed fraud. Additionally, the one-time passcode sent to the cardholder's registered phone was not completed for the session that made the $44.43 purchase, and the connection went through an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS). In response to this activity, the bank has recommended blocking card C08168-K1 (L1), created an automated case, placed connected cards under monitoring, filed this report (L2), and escalated the matter to an analyst.
